candidates.statement: Elena has guarded the Salt bridge for eleven years.
candidates.subject: Elena
candidates.quote: Elena llevaba once años custodiando el puente de Sal

candidates.statement: Bruno sold the bridge key to the people of Ribera.
candidates.subject: Bruno
candidates.quote: Dicen que Bruno vendió la llave del puente a los de Ribera
candidates.uncertainty: The guard says he did not see it; the source is tavern talk.

candidates.statement: Elena states that the key lies under the altar slab.
candidates.subject: Elena
candidates.quote: La llave está bajo la losa del altar

candidates.statement: The key lies under the altar slab, and Clara finds it there.
candidates.subject: Clara
candidates.quote: Clara levantó la losa del altar y encontró debajo la llave del puente

candidates.statement: Elena knew nothing about the hiding place before that night.
candidates.subject: Elena
candidates.quote: Elena, que hasta esa noche no había sabido nada del escondite
